name: Tilicho Lake from Manang
why: A side trip from the Annapurna Circuit to one of the highest lakes of its size on Earth, under the ice walls of Tilicho Peak.
book: Annapurna Conservation Area permit and TIMS card. Since April 2023 Nepal requires foreign trekkers to hire a licensed guide in its national parks and conservation areas (check the current rule before you go). Lodges at Shree Kharka and Tilicho Base Camp.
water: Lodges at Shree Kharka and Base Camp; nothing above.
dangers: The landslide traverse before Base Camp: scree and falling stones, walk it early and without stopping.
The lake is at 4,919 m: only after two nights at Manang.
turnaround: Leave Base Camp by 05:00 and turn back at noon wherever you are.

points.name: Manang

points.name: Tilicho Lake
